instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thank you <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.

    for t in res.get('no_section_tasks', []):

todoist_token=globals().get('todoist_token')
assert todoist_token
# mapping of task_id -> (new_assignee_email, thank_first_name)
reassignments={
    2672: ('ad.blackburn@gmail.com','Adam'),
    2682: ('connorbrow@gmail.com','Connor'),
    2683: ('ashlee_martinez@gmail.com','Ashlee'),
    2694: ('angriddle@gmail.com','Angela'),
}

results=[]
for task_id,(email,first_name) in reassignments.items():
    r=apis.todoist.assign_or_unassign_task(access_token=todoist_token, task_id=task_id, assignee_email=email)
    results.append((task_id,email, r))
    print('assigned task', task_id, 'to', email, '->', r)

print('total_assign_results', len(results))

todoist_token=globals().get('todoist_token')
comment_actions=[
    (2672,'Adam'),
    (2682,'Connor'),
    (2683,'Ashlee'),
    (2694,'Angela'),
]
post_results=[]
for task_id, first_name in comment_actions:
    content=f'Thank you {first_name}!'
    res=apis.todoist.post_task_comment(access_token=todoist_token, task_id=task_id, content=content)
    post_results.append((task_id,first_name,res))
    print('posted comment on task',task_id,'->',res)
print('post_count',len(post_results))

todoist_token=globals().get('todoist_token')
assert todoist_token

expected_assign={
    2672:'ad.blackburn@gmail.com',
    2682:'connorbrow@gmail.com',
    2683:'ashlee_martinez@gmail.com',
    2694:'angriddle@gmail.com'
}

unchanged_tasks=[1357,1386,2674,2678]

# fetch comments for a task (all pages)
def get_all_comments(task_id):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.todoist.show_task_comments(access_token=todoist_token, task_id=task_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        out.extend(res)
        if len(res)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    return out

# show_task once per task
all_tasks_to_check=set(list(expected_assign.keys())+unchanged_tasks)

verification={}
for tid in sorted(all_tasks_to_check):
    task=apis.todoist.show_task(access_token=todoist_token, task_id=tid)
    comments=get_all_comments(tid)
    verification[tid]={
        'assignee_email': (task.get('assignee') or {}).get('email'),
        'comments_count': len(comments),
        'comment_contents': [c.get('content') for c in comments]
    }
    print('TASK',tid,'assignee',verification[tid]['assignee_email'],'comments_count',verification[tid]['comments_count'])
    # print any 'Thank you' comments
    tg=[c for c in verification[tid]['comment_contents'] if isinstance(c,str) and c.startswith('Thank you ')]
    print('  thank_you_comments:', tg)

# validate
success=True
# check expected tasks
for tid,email in expected_assign.items():
    if verification[tid]['assignee_email']!=email:
        success=False
        print('FAIL assignee for',tid,'expected',email,'got',verification[tid]['assignee_email'])
    # check exact comment content
    # Determine first_name from expected assignment
    first_name_map={
        'ad.blackburn@gmail.com':'Adam',
        'connorbrow@gmail.com':'Connor',
        'ashlee_martinez@gmail.com':'Ashlee',
        'angriddle@gmail.com':'Angela'
    }
    expected_content=f"Thank you {first_name_map[email]}!"
    if expected_content not in verification[tid]['comment_contents']:
        success=False
        print('FAIL missing comment on',tid,'expected_content',expected_content,'contents',verification[tid]['comment_contents'])

# check unchanged tasks remain assigned to Jordan
for tid in unchanged_tasks:
    assignee=verification[tid]['assignee_email']
    if assignee!='jo-harr@gmail.com':
        success=False
        print('FAIL unchanged assignee for',tid,'expected jo-harr@gmail.com got',assignee)

    # ensure none of Thank you ... comments were added
    tg=[c for c in verification[tid]['comment_contents'] if isinstance(c,str) and c.startswith('Thank you ')]
    if tg:
        success=False
        print('FAIL unexpected thank you comment on',tid,tg)

print('verification_success',success)

if not success:
    print('Not completing task due to verification failure')
else:
    completion=apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
    print('completion',completion)
